summary: DART 주요사항보고서 (tier-1 primary filing): board resolved to purchase 53,285,968 common shares for KRW 14,999,999,992,000 between 2026-08-24 and 2026-11-21 via on-market purchase, brokered by Samsung Securities, Shinhan and KB. Reference price KRW 281,500 (2026-08-21 close). Daily order limit 7,321,653 shares. Purpose: EMPLOYEE SHARE COMPENSATION (performance incentives, special performance bonus).
source: DART 주요사항보고서 자기주식 취득 결정, 2026-08-21 (user-supplied PDF)
analyst_note: Only weakly supportive. This tranche is for employee compensation, NOT cancellation - it offsets dilution rather than reducing share count. Roughly 0.91% of common per year. Do not count it as accretive capital return.

summary: Same tier-1 filing: treasury-purchase headroom KRW 222,623,486,825,081, derived from separate-basis net assets KRW 254,330,082,981,146 less capital stock KRW 897,513,820,000 and reserves KRW 6,689,493,671,724 and unrealised gains KRW 3,676,248,819,537.
analyst_note: Strongest single survivability datapoint in the file and it is tier-1.

summary: Same tier-1 filing: five independent directors attended the resolution with none absent; the audit committee is composed entirely of independent directors, all present.

Board approved a 2026 shareholder return of approximately KRW 90-110T, more than 5x the previous record of KRW 20.3T (2020). Roughly KRW 30T of cash dividend in Q3 2026; the remaining split between dividend and buyback-and-cancel is decided at the January 2027 board.
analyst_note: 5.5-6.7% one-year shareholder yield on approximately KRW 1,634T of total equity value. Press reporting on the MULTI-YEAR figure conflicts (KRW 90T buyback over 3 years vs KRW 120-140T 3-year total) - recorded as unresolved.

summary: Cancelled 73,359,314 common and 13,603,461 preferred treasury shares, approximately KRW 14.58T. Common shares outstanding fell 5,919,637,922 to 5,846,278,608 (-1.24%); preferred treasury holding went to zero.
analyst_note: Cross-verified against the 2026-08-21 tier-1 filing, which states 1% of common issued = 58,462,786 shares. Real share-count reduction, unlike the employee-compensation tranche.

summary: Q2 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 171.5T and operating profit KRW 89.5T, both quarterly records; operating margin 52.2% versus 43% in Q1. HBM4 supply expanding with industry-first HBM4E samples shipped; HBM4 expected to exceed 60% of Samsung HBM revenue in H2. Foundry improved on HBM base-die and US customer demand.
analyst_note: A 52.2% company-wide operating margin INCLUDING handsets, display and Harman is a cycle peak, not a steady state. Supports the moat thesis; must not be capitalised.

summary: Q1 2026 operating profit KRW 57.2T. Combined with Q2, H1 2026 operating profit is KRW 146.7T versus FY2025 full-year KRW 43.60T.
FY2025 revenue KRW 333.61T (+10.9% YoY) and operating profit KRW 43.60T (+33.2% YoY).
analyst_note: Baseline for normalisation. Prior all-time peak operating profit was KRW 58.9T in 2018 - the level the current price implicitly requires to be exceeded by 2.5-3.1x on a sustained basis.

summary: Counterpoint: Samsung HBM share rose 21% (Q1 2026) to 33% (Q2 2026); SK hynix fell from 64% a year earlier to 50%.
analyst_note: SOURCE CONFLICT: a separate report cites Samsung 38% / SK hynix 25% for Q2 2026, which appears to conflate a year-end TARGET with an actual. Counterpoint preferred - named research house with a consistent quarterly series, corroborated by Businesspost. Direction agrees across sources; level does not.

summary: Samsung passed final HBM4 qualification at NVIDIA and AMD first and began shipments in Q2 2026, securing a position on the NVIDIA Rubin platform. When customers raised the HBM4 speed spec in Q4 2025, Samsung's part passed without redesign. Reported HBM4 yield approximately 80%. Samsung plans to more than triple HBM4 revenue in Q3 2026.
analyst_note: The single strongest moat-trajectory datapoint. Yield figure is press-reported (ESTIMATE-grade) but the qualification pass is corroborated across multiple sources.

summary: SK hynix HBM4 mass production slipped to Q3 2026 on interface sync issues; capacity redirected to DDR5/LPDDR5 and full-year HBM4 shipments revised down significantly.
analyst_note: Supports Samsung's share gain but ALSO weakens it: a gain caused by a competitor's stumble is not the same as a durable technology lead. Re-test at Q3/Q4 2026.

summary: Foundry utilisation exceeded 80% in Q1 2026, the highest in about a year. Tesla AI5 won alongside TSMC with 3nm yields stabilising; breakeven target pulled forward from 2027 to 2026, with Q3 2026 breakeven reported as the expectation. AI4 produced at Pyeongtaek; AI5/AI6 at the US$37B Taylor site.
analyst_note: Fixes the division that has been the company's largest structural weakness for a decade. Still a distant second to TSMC, whose Q2 2026 revenue was US$40.20B with a full-year growth outlook above +40%.

summary: Supreme Court confirmed acquittal of Chairman Lee Jae-yong on all 19 charges relating to the Samsung C&T / Cheil Industries merger and Samsung Biologics accounting, finding no proof of crime. Ends approximately nine years of legal overhang.
analyst_note: Clears the management_or_accounting_integrity Hard Veto. Source summaries carried a conflicting 2024 date; article URLs and dates consistently indicate 2025-07-17.

summary: Combined 2027 capex for Samsung, SK hynix and Micron projected at US$146B (approximately KRW 209T), about 3.4x the US$43B of 2024. DRAM makers raised 2026 capex by an average of more than 40%, with meaningful shipment expansion arriving from H2 2027 onward. Samsung's own plan exceeds KRW 110T of facility and R&D investment; Pyeongtaek P5 fab1 KRW 60T+ with fab2 similar (2029 target).
analyst_note: THE PRIMARY BEAR MECHANISM. This is how memory incremental ROIC has collapsed in every prior cycle, and the capital is being committed now at the peak. Sources genuinely disagree on outcome: SK hynix's CEO forecasts the worst-ever shortage in 2027, while other analysis expects new-line startups to ease supply in 2028-2030.

summary: Common close KRW 250,000 on 2026-09-03 (KOSPI 6,579.48), down from KRW 281,500 on 2026-08-21 and KRW 260,000 on 2026-08-31. Common-share market capitalisation approximately KRW 1,462T; total equity value approximately KRW 1,634T including preferred at an estimated KRW 215,000.

Forward P/B approximately 2.29x against 2026E BPS of KRW 109,313, versus a historical Samsung range of roughly 0.9x-2.1x. CORRECTION: the screening run of the same date cited approximately 1.4x forward P/B from a broker source and used it as a primary SCREEN_IN argument; that figure appears to reference 2025 and is stale.
analyst_note: This correction is the single most consequential change from the screening run. It removes the 'price does not require the peak to persist' argument in the strong form it was originally stated, and is why expectation_gap_score is 6/15 rather than the 8-10 the screening note implied.
